oneLine: Investors likely to sell a 9% stake in Nephrocare Health Services in a block deal.

sources.title: Nephrocare Health Services Block Deal: Investors likely to sell 9% stake at ₹705/share

synopsis: Existing investors including private equity funds, family trusts, and individuals are likely to sell up to an 8.9% stake in Nephrocare Health Services Ltd through a block deal valued at ₹650 crore. The base offer size is 5.5% worth ₹400 crore with an upsize option of 3.4% worth ₹250 crore. The offer price is set at ₹705 per share. Sellers listed include Investcorp Private Equity Fund II, Healthcare Parent Limited, Investcorp India Private Equity Opportunity Limited, Edoras Investment Holdings Pte Ltd, Quadria Capital India Fund III, Bessemer Venture Partners Trust, Vikram Vuppala, Viraaj Family Trust, and Manvi Family Trust.
